```plato

    //==
    // Kis — raise a pyramid on every face
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kleetope). Every face of arity n becomes n
    // triangles meeting at its apex. Tetrahedron -> triakis tetrahedron,
    // octahedron -> tetrakis hexahedron at the right height. The Conway identity
    // is k = dtd, but the direct construction below needs no dual and so stays
    // exact on a mesh whose face planes pass near the origin.
    // V' = V + F, E' = E + C, F' = C.

    // The triangle a corner contributes: its own edge, closed onto its face's
    // apex. Wound counter-clockwise seen from outside, like the face it replaces.
    KisFaceOfCorner(self: PolygonMesh3D, corner: CornerIndex): Array<VertexIndex>
        => [self.CornerVertex(corner),
            self.CornerDestination(corner),
            self.ApexVertex(self.CornerFace(corner))];
```
